text_en: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
Do not be sad, indeed Allah is with us.
And He is with you wherever you are.
Glory be to Allah and His is the praise.
And be patient for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes.

text_ar: مَنْ جَعَلَ الهُمُومَ هَمًّا وَاحِدًا، هَمَّ المَعَادِ، كَفَاهُ اللَّهُ هَمَّ دُنْيَاهُ
text_en: Whoever makes all his concerns into one concern, the concern of the Hereafter, Allah will suffice him for his worldly concerns.
Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured.
Sufficient for us is Allah, and [He is] the best Disposer of affairs.
But My mercy encompasses all things.

text_ar: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
text_en: How wonderful is the case of a believer; there is good for him in everything.
